name: timothywarner-org/ai901-cert-buddy-claude
summary: 据发布者介绍，这款 Claude Code 学习助手可用于备考 Azure AI Fundamentals（AI-901），提供练习题、Microsoft Foundry 实验和学习计划，并通过 MCP 参考 Microsoft Learn 资料。
The publisher describes a Claude Code study companion for Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-901), with practice questions, Microsoft Foundry labs, and study plans. It draws on Microsoft Learn via MCP.
